operations.title: The physical wall cocycle is liftable but has no canonical lift into T7
operations.statement: The exact localization sequence has ranks 0->9->15->6->0. A fixed physical boundary class has a rank-nine affine space of absolute lifts; imposing zero elliptic image leaves a rank-seven T7 torsor, not a preferred lift.

operations.title: Rank and arrow-direction gate for the physical shared-wall lift
operations.method: Combine the three-wall deletion ranks with H3(S_E)=0 and the 9=7+2 infinity-Gysin sequence; compute the torsor ranks and test whether localization supplies a reverse arrow.
